DAVIET Hosts Distinguished Alumna Ms Rubeen Gill for an Expert Talk on Technology Leadership
As part of its Silver Jubilee Celebrations, DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, organised an expert talk by its distinguished alumna, Ms Rubeen Gill, Senior Technical Program Manager at Mastercard . The session was titled "From Software Engineering to Strategic Technology Leadership." Dr Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal, DAVIET , appreciated the participation of the distinguished alumna and stated that accomplished alumni serve as role models for students. He observed that interactions with successful professionals provide valuable industry exposure, practical insights and inspiration, helping students make informed career choices.
DAVIET Strengthens Industry–Academia Ties: Corporate Leaders from Samco International and MCK Impex Explore Collaborative Opportunities
DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, recently hosted an interaction with two distinguished industry representatives, Mr. Sanjeev Juneja, Managing Director, Samco International and Chairman, IIF Chandigarh Chapter, and Mr. Manish Kwatra, Director, MCK IMPEX, Jalandhar and Secretary, IIF Chandigarh Chapter. The interaction focused on exploring collaborative opportunities between the institute and the corporate sector to strengthen professional training, experiential learning and student employability. Dr. Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal, DAVIET, emphasised that industry–academia collaboration plays a pivotal role in strengthening the quality and relevance of technical education.
DAVIET Celebrates Vishwakarma Day with Traditional Pooja Ceremony
The Department of Mechanical Engineering at DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, celebrated Vishwakarma Day on 10th November 2026 with devotion and traditional fervour. A special Pooja Ceremony was organised in the Turning Shop of the Mechanical Engineering Department Laboratory to mark the auspicious occasion. The celebration paid tribute to Lord Vishwakarma, revered as the divine architect and the patron deity of craftsmen, engineers and artisans. The ceremony was graced by Dr Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal, DAVIET, whose presence added significance to the occasion.
Congratulations to all
DAVIET STUDENTS WIN HACKATHON WITH SHAREMESH INNOVATION
Students of DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, have brought laurels to the institution by winning ₹ 11000 at a prestigious 30 hour offline hackathon organised in Jalandhar. Competing against more than 150 teams comprising over 500 participants from various colleges and universities, the DAVIET team secured recognition for its innovative project, ShareMesh . The hackathon provided a competitive platform for young innovators to demonstrate their technical abilities through coding, hardware prototyping and live presentations before an expert jury. With a total prize pool exceeding ₹1,00,000, the event recognised outstanding technological solutions through cash prizes, gadgets, trophies and certificates. Dr. Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal, DAVIET , congratulated the students on their achievement and stated that their success reflected the institution's commitment to nurturing innovation, technical excellence and an entrepreneurial mindset.
DAVIET CELEBRATES SHWETA'S DOUBLE SUCCESS IN INDIAN AIR FORCE SELECTION
DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, takes immense pride in celebrating the remarkable achievement of Shweta from the Department of Computer Science Engineering , who has successfully cleared the Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT) and earned recommendations in two successive selection attempts, first on 13 February and subsequently on 5 June. She is currently undergoing training at the Indian Air Force Academy, Hyderabad, and upon successful completion of her training will be commissioned as an officer in the Indian Air Force. Congratulating Shweta, Dr Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal , stated that her accomplishment exemplifies perseverance, self discipline and an unwavering commitment to excellence. He observed that such achievements inspire fellow students to pursue ambitious career aspirations and bring distinction to the institution. Lt Jaswinder Singh Dhillon also congratulated Shweta, appreciating her dedication, determination and commitment towards serving the nation. He expressed confidence that she would uphold the highest standards of professionalism and excellence in her future responsibilities. The institute congratulates Shweta on this significant milestone and wishes her a successful training period and a distinguished career in the Indian Air Force.
DAVIET WOMEN'S CHESS TEAM RETAINS IKG PTU TITLE; MEN'S TEAM SECURES SECOND RUNNER UP POSITION
The Women's Chess Team of DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, has brought distinction to the institute by winning the IKG PTU Inter College Chess Championship for the second consecutive year. The Men's Chess Team further enhanced the institute's sporting achievements by securing the Second Runner Up position in the tournament. The championship witnessed commendable performances by both teams, reflecting their strategic ability, concentration and competitive spirit. Dr Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal, stated that the achievement reflects DAVIET's commitment to holistic education and the development of students beyond the classroom. He emphasised that sports play a vital role in nurturing discipline, analytical thinking, resilience and leadership qualities. Dr Jaswinder Singh Dhillon, President Sports, appreciated the players for their dedication, perseverance and consistent performance.
DAVIET ORGANISES BADGE DISTRIBUTION CEREMONY FOR NEWLY APPOINTED CLASS REPRESENTATIVES
DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, organised a badge distribution ceremony to honour its newly appointed Class Representatives (CRs). The ceremony commenced with a warm welcome to the Principal and the Deans. Addressing the gathering, the Director cum Principal Dr Sandeep Vij congratulated the newly appointed representatives and highlighted their role as a vital link between students and faculty.
DAVIET EMPOWERS POSTAL OFFICERS THROUGH BUSINESS AND MARKETING SKILLS TRAINING
DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology's Centre for Corporate Training (DAVIET CCT), successfully organised two (3 day each) Capacity Building Programmes on "Business and Marketing Skills for Middle Management Officers" for Inspectors of Posts (IPs), Assistant Superintendents of Posts (ASPOs) and Postal Services Group 'B' officers from the Department of Posts. The programme aimed to strengthen managerial competencies through contemporary marketing practices, digital strategies and artificial intelligence (AI) driven tools for improved public service delivery. Addressing the participants, Dr. Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal, DAVIET , emphasised the need for public sector organisations to embrace technological advancement and customer centric governance. He highlighted that the effective integration of data analytics, generative AI and digital tools into routine operations can improve service efficiency, strengthen public trust and foster responsive, citizen focused administration. He further underscored the importance of continuous learning, adaptability and strategic thinking in enabling middle management officers to respond effectively to evolving public expectations.
DAVIET EXPLORES INTERDISCIPLINARY APPLICATIONS OF MATHEMATICS THROUGH EXPERT LECTURE
The Research, Innovation & Consultancy (RIC) Cell of DAV Institute of Engineering & Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, in collaboration with the Department of Applied Sciences, organised an expert lecture on "Applications of Mathematics in Emerging Areas of Science, Technology, and Management." The session featured Dr. Gagan Deep, Associate Professor and Head, PG Department of Mathematics, Hans Raj Mahila Maha Vidyalaya, Jalandhar, as the keynote speaker. The programme brought faculty members together to examine the relevance of mathematical concepts in contemporary research, technological progress and professional practice. Dr. Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal, welcomed Dr. Gagan Deep and acknowledged her efforts in sharing her academic expertise with the faculty. He emphasised that mathematical thinking is essential to understanding complex challenges in science, engineering, technology and management.
DAVIET Organises Expert Talk on Blockchain Technology
The Department of Business Management at DAV Institute of Engineering & Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, organised an expert talk on "Blockchain Technology: Applications Shaping the Digital Age". Dr. Sanjeev Gupta, Professor, School of Commerce and Management, Central University of Himachal Pradesh, was the resource person for the session. The programme witnessed the participation of 100 students and 13 faculty members, providing an academic platform to explore the growing relevance of blockchain technology in contemporary business and digital ecosystems.
Congratulations to all
03 STUDENTS FROM ELECTRONICS & COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING BRANCH OF DAVIET SELECTED FOR 3AIP SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
The 03 students from Electronics & Communication Engineering Branch of DAV Institute of Engineering & Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar who will be passing out in July 2027 were selected for 3AIP Services Private Limited. Dr. Sandeep Vij, Principal DAVIET congratulated the students on their success. He wished them the best of luck for all their future endeavors'. He highlighted that DAVIETians have always been passionate about placements and special efforts are done to make them industry ready.
DAVIET HOSTS NASSCOM DELEGATION FOR SKILL DEVELOPMENT OF STUDENTS
DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, hosted a NASSCOM delegation to improve students' employability by introducing them to emerging industry requirements and providing opportunities for experiential learning and upskilling. Ms Priyanka Bisht, Deputy Director of NASSCOM, and Mr Anish Kumar, Manager of NASSCOM, led the session. They engaged with students and emphasised the significance of acquiring industry relevant skills to remain competitive in the changing professional landscape.
Congratulations to all
DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, secured the bronze medal in the men's category at the IKG Punjab Technical University (IKG PTU) Inter College Basketball Tournament 2026–27, held at ACPTE, Mastuana Sahib, on October 6 and 7, 2026. Director cum Principal Dr Sandeep Vij congratulated the team on its achievement and appreciated the players for representing DAVIET with dedication and competitive spirit. He stated that sports play a vital role in the holistic development of students by fostering discipline, leadership, teamwork and resilience.
In a notable placement achievement, five B.Tech students of DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, from the batch graduating in July 2027, have secured employment opportunities with GreyB Research, a multinational innovation consulting company, at an annual salary package of ₹7 lakh per annum (LPA). The achievement reflects the institution's continued emphasis on technical competence, professional preparedness and the development of skills aligned with evolving industry requirements. Dr. Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal, DAVIET , congratulated the selected students and described their achievement as a source of pride for the institution. He emphasised that DAVIET remains committed to providing an academic environment that encourages students to develop technical expertise, independent thinking, professional competence and the confidence to succeed in a competitive global workplace.
Students of DAV Institute of Engineering & Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, have brought distinction to the institution by securing several prominent positions in the I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University (IKGPTU) Merit List for the passing year 2026. The merit list features students from B.Tech. and M.Tech. programmes. Dr Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal , DAVIET, congratulated the students on their achievement and appreciated their commitment to academic excellence. He stated that the presence of DAVIET students in the IKGPTU merit list was a matter of pride for the institution and reflected the culture of academic discipline and sustained effort encouraged at DAVIET.
The DAV Institute of Engineering & Technology (DAVIET) successfully organised the prestigious Drona Awards 2026 in collaboration with 92.7 BIG FM . The event was to recognize, honor, and facilitate the relentless hard work, dedication, and contributions of school principals, teachers, and students from across Jalandhar and surrounding regions. Dr. Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal of DAVIET, delivered an inspiring welcome address, formally inaugurating the proceedings. He emphasized the pivotal role of teachers in shaping young minds, nurturing values, and laying the foundation for a progressive society.
DAV Institute of Engineering & Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, organised a Blood Donation Camp , to commemorate NSS Day. The camp was organised by the NSS Unit, Red Ribbon Club and Youth Red Cross Club in collaboration with the Indian Red Cross Society and Knowledge Villa Integrated Education & Welfare Society (KVIEWS). Approximately 150 students attended the camp, reflecting the institution's commitment to social responsibility and community service. Addressing the gathering, Dr. Sandeep Vij emphasised that voluntary blood donation is a noble humanitarian act that can help save precious lives.
DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, organised a Hawan and Ved Katha programme at Arya Samaj, Bikrampura, Jalandhar. The programme brought together the institution's leadership, faculty members and students to participate in Vedic rituals and reflect on the relevance of Vedic teachings in contemporary life. The programme was attended by Principal Inderjeet Talwar, Shri Ajay Goswami, General Secretary, DAV College Managing Committee (DAVCMC), and Principal Sharma. The proceedings were hosted by Dr Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal, DAVIET, along with faculty members and students of the institute. Addressing the gathering, Dr Sandeep Vij emphasised that education should extend beyond academic excellence to encompass moral values, spiritual awareness and character building
Congratulations to all
DAVIET Jalandhar has achieved a significant milestone in academic and professional excellence as Liza Bassan , a student of Civil Engineering, and Akshit Sharma , a student of Electrical Engineering, received the prestigious ISTE Best Student Award 2026 at MIET Jammu. Congratulating the awardees, Dr. Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal , DAVIET, expressed immense pride in their accomplishment and stated that such recognitions reflect the institution's strong academic foundation and its sustained efforts towards nurturing technically competent, confident and professionally responsible engineers.
16 B.TECH STUDENTS OF DAVIET SELECTED FOR INTERNSHIP WITH STMICROELECTRONICS
Sixteen B.Tech students of DAV Institute of Engineering & Technology (DAVIET) , Jalandhar, have been selected for internship by STMicroelectronics, a leading global semiconductor company, marking a significant achievement for the institute and its students. The selected students, who are graduating in July 2027, will join the company as Software Engineer Interns and will have the opportunity to work with its Research and Development (R&D) teams in areas related to product designing and chip manufacturing. Dr. Sandeep Vij, Director cum Principal, DAVIET, congratulated the selected students on their achievement and wished them success in their professional careers. He stated that the selection of 16 students for internship by STMicroelectronics is a significant accomplishment and reflects the sustained efforts of DAVIET towards making students industry ready through focused academic and professional training.
Congratulations to all
DAVIET Chess women's team won the chess championship and Boys team secured 2nd runner up position at IKG PTU inter college Chess tournament held at Amritsar group of colleges on 20th and 21st Jan, 2026.

Welcome to DAV Institute of Engineering & Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, a pioneering institution in the realm of technical education. Established in 2001 under the aegis of the DAV College Managing Committee (DAVCMC), New Delhi, which manages a chain of more than 970 institutions in India and abroad, DAVIET stands as a beacon of excellence in engineering, technology, and professional education. Approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and affiliated with I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University, Jalandhar, DAVIET is the first degree level engineering institute established by the Dayanand Anglo Vedic College Managing Committee, New Delhi.
Situated in the heart of Jalandhar city on an expansive 18 acre campus adjacent to DAV College, DAVIET boasts a picturesque landscape with a running canal at its rear and the historic Burlton Park at its forefront. Our institute fosters original research and technological advancements at the forefront of innovation.
At DAVIET, we are committed to nurturing competent, motivated engineers and scientists through outcome based education. We strongly emphasize imparting training that cultivates technical prowess and instils human values and environmental consciousness. We pride ourselves in the collaborations and MOUs with leading institutions in the world namely the University of Ontario, The Institute of Technology, Canada, and the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Ropar, DAVIET is committed to providing quality education and world class exposure to all our students. With an exemplary track record in placements, DAVIET has forged alliances with over 200 esteemed companies for internships and job placements. In the past two years alone, more than 700 of our students have secured internships or employment opportunities. Notably, one of our B.Tech students recently clinched an international placement with a remarkable pay package of 70 LPA, a testament to the quality of education and training imparted at DAVIET.
We take pride in our numerous accolades, including the IKG Punjab Technical University Youth Festival Trophy, which we have won an unprecedented 23 times. DAVIET also serves as an excellent hub for incubation and entrepreneurship, fostering a culture of innovation and enterprise among our students.
Our institute boasts state of the art facilities and centers of excellence, including the Microsoft Certified Campus, Texas Instruments Innovation Lab, IBM Academy, Huawei Academy and CISCO Networking Academy, among others. These collaborations equip our students with hands on experience and industry relevant skills, ensuring their readiness for the dynamic professional landscape.
At DAVIET, research is at the forefront of our endeavors, with proactive initiatives spanning a multitude of disciplines, from lightwave communication and robotics to organic chemistry and computational intelligence. Our faculty and students are engaged in cutting edge research that addresses contemporary challenges and contributes to societal advancement.
Join us at DAVIET, where academic excellence, innovation, and societal impact converge to shape the engineers and technologists of tomorrow. Discover a vibrant learning community that celebrates diversity, fosters creativity, and empowers individuals to realize their fullest potential.tjal.org/about/

DAVIETians ENLIGHTENED ABOUT DISTRICT LEGAL SERVICES
The Department of National Service Scheme (NSS) and Internal Complaint Committee (ICC) of DAVIET organized a Seminar on District Legal Services on the Institute Campus on 7 December 2022 . The seminar was organized to create awareness among the students about the availability of free and competent legal aid in the form of counselling and legal advice along with free legal services in the conduct of cases before courts and tribunals.
Dr Sanjeev Naval , Off. Principal accorded a green welcome the Key Note SpeakerDr Gagandeep Kaur and the resource personn Ms Parveen Abrol.
The Key Note Speaker was Dr Gagandeep Kaur , Chief Judicial Magistrate, Jalandhar. In her talk, she highlighted that the Indian Constitution is the basis from which all the laws originate. Dr Gagandeep discussed different articles in the constitution like Article 39 A that ensures access to justice for all. She also shared the fact that sound legal advice and services are available for anyone in need of them. She shared with all the present that the District Legal Services Authority is committed to spreading legal awareness among the masses highlighting the importance of good legal advice. She also shared that the Department aims to render free legal aid to under trial prisoners whose cases are pending in courts.
Ms Parveen Abrol , the learned Resource Person talked about the District Legal Services Authority and shared that the Lok Adalats play an important role in society. They save time, and energy leading to mental peace. She also highlighted the importance of women's empowerment in today's society. She highlighted that everyone has equal rights irrespective of gender. Women have been on the back foot economically and socially, but she added, that the good news is that now women are realising their true potential and outshining men.
Dr Sanjeev Naval , Principal, stated that all of us must be aware of our rights. But at the same time, he highlighted, that we should know about the legal guidance and services that are readily available to us. He shared the life of Dr BR Ambedkar and credited him for creating the constitution of India, which safeguards the interests of everyone. He thanked the Keynote speaker Dr Gagandeep Kaur for apprising the students and teachers about the activities of the District Legal Services Department. He also appreciated the efforts of the NSS wing and Internal Complaint Committee (ICC) of the Institute and encouraged Dr Ashok Kumar, the NSS Program Officer, Dr Suman Tondon, Incharge ICC, and Dr Shivani Vij, the Program Co ordinator to continue the good work.
Dr Ashok Kumar expressed his gratitude towards the Keynote Speaker Dr Gagandeep Kaur for a highly enlightening talk. He also thanked Dr Sanjeev Naval for his constant support and assured that the NSS wing will leave no stone unturned to serve society.
Workshop on 'Prevention of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act 2013'
The Internal Complaint Committee (ICC) in collaboration with The Gender Sensitization Cell (GSC) of DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology, Jalandhar organized a workshop on 'Prevention of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act 2013' on November 25, 2022, to highlight the need of women safety and security. The basic aim to conduct this workshop was to aware the women employees and students about the provisions of the Act for their empowerment. Over 300 students of the Institute attended this workshop. Advocate Tania Bhatti was the speaker on the occasion. Dr. Sudhir Sharma, Principal, DAVIET gave a green welcome to Advocate Bhatti.
Advocate Tania Bhatti is also an active social worker. She highlighted various provision of 'Prevention of Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act 2013'. She stated about the rights and powers of women for their empowerment. She threw light on four important articles such as Article 14 i.e right to equality, Article 15 i.e discrimination on the basis of sex, Article 19(1)(g) i.e practice of right of women to carry any business/practice, Article 21 i.e right to life. She discussed various significant judgments of some cases. Further, she gave overview of Posh Act and enlightened the audience.
Dr. Sudhir Sharma, Principal, DAVIET appreciated the participants of this workshop. In his speech, he stated that Gender Sensitization Cell and Internal complaint Committee of DAVIET are playing preventive role also and the cells have regular meetings with students in the Institute. Further, he mentioned that we all should realize the importance to generate awareness of welfare services intended for women in India.
The audience had an interactive session with Advocate Bhatti. She gave tips to the present female audience. All present got benefitted from this awareness workshop.
At the end of valediction, Advocate Tania Bhatti was presented a token of gratitude by Dr. Sudhir Sharma with team members of ICC and GSC.

Student Grievance Redressal Policy
DAV Institute of Engineering & Technology, Jalandhar (DAVIET) has an established mechanism for redressal of students grievances related to academic and non academic matters viz. victimization, attendance, charging of fee, conduct of examinations /assessment/evaluation, library, centralized facilities, hostel mess, canteen, harassment by co students or teachers/ supporting staff etc.
1. Objectives of Grievance Redressal Committee:
The purpose of the Grievance Redressal committees is to ensure a speedy response to any complaint by the students of DAVIET, Jalandhar.
The objective(s) of the Grievance Redressal Committee are as under:
1. Maintaining harmonious Student – Student and faculty/Staff Student
2. Creating an environment in which students can freely express their grievances without fear of discrimination or victimization
3. Counselling students to refrain provoking of their fellow students against faculty and staff of the
2. Jurisdiction of the Committee
The committee shall deal with grievances received in writing about any of the following:
Academic Matters – Issues related to marks/ grades and other examination related matter, Transfer Certificate, Harassment
Financial Matter – relating to dues and payments
Administrative Matters – Infrastructure related, library, hostel, canteen & central facilities, food, sanitation, victimization
3. Grievance Redressal Committee
The Principal shall constitute the Grievance Redressal Committee at the institute level. The composition of the Grievance Redressal Committee is as under:
• The Dean (Student Affairs) Chairman
• The Deputy Dean(s) (Student Affairs) Member/Members Member
• 01 faculty member from each department Member
4. Procedure for Redressal of Grievance
An aggrieved student shall first submit his complaint in writing to his/her mentor who shall resolve the grievance with 02 days. In case the mentor is not able to resolve the grievance, she/he shall forward it to the chairperson of the Grievance Redressal Committee.
The chairperson of Committee shall convene a meeting of the committee within 02 days of receiving the complaint from the faculty mentor or from the aggr· ved student in case he/she applies directly to the committee. The chairperson shall attempt to resolve the grievance within a week of the receipt of the complaint.
If the student is not satisfied with the solution of the committee, he/she shall appeal to the worthy Principal giving the reasons for his/her dissatisfaction with the decision within a week of receipt of the decision.
The worthy Principal shall convene a meeting of the committee with 02 days of receiving the complaint. The Principal shall review the decision and pass an appropriate order. The Principal, if needed may recommend necessary corrective action to ensure avoidance of recurrence of similar grievance in the Institute.

DEPARTMENT OF TRAINING & PLACEMENT
The Institute has a full fledged Training & Placement Cell to look after the Placement activities. The Training and Placement cell provides the official support base for placement of Final year & Pre Final year students. The support services that it offers are in the form of arranging campus interviews, grooming students to face the final test of their knowledge, create and arrange value added Industrial/Practical Training to the students. The institute is equipped with two centrally air conditioned Auditoriums (with a seating capacity of 1200 and 350) for holding Pre Placement Talk, two conference rooms for conducting group discussion sessions, seminar hall and well furnished rooms & offices for conducting interviews. The Placement Office is fully computerized. The Steering Committee of the Placement cell is headed by the Training & Placement Officer of the rank of Assistant Professor and Industrial Coordinators from each department of the rank of lecturers. In addition to the support staff, four students from each department are contributing as Student Placement Coordinators.

Invitations are sent to the prospective companies / organizations along with all relevant information to participate in the campus recruitment. Regular correspondence is maintained with various industries. Personal visits by the Training and Placement Officer, to many companies also serves to build and maintain relations with the companies. The cell maintains a branch wise list of industries and encourages students to approach the companies independently in case that particular company does not have a policy of Campus Recruitment.
The cell maintains a branch wise record of all current appearing students in the Final Year and Pre Final Year through the collection of their resumes. Based on the requirements prescribed by the company, the eligible candidates are invited for appearing for the test/interviews that are conducted by the visiting companies.
The Training & Placement Cell also maintains a list of past students and passes this list to companies who specifically come for pass out students.

The Training and Placement Cell firmly believes in taking feedback from the companies that have visited the Institute since the feedback from the company serves as a yardstick regarding the performance of the students. DAV Institute of Engineering and Technology is a premier educational Institution of North India, providing quality education to aspiring technocrats, managers, entrepreneurs and professionals. It is managed by DAV College Managing Committee which has over 130 years experience in the field of education. It has 30,000,00 active students currently enrolled in more than 850 colleges and schools across the country and 40,000,00 alumni serving the society in various capacities. DAVIET has carved out a niche for itself owing to the strong academia industry interface with the emphasis on promoting original research to make the students proficient in both technical and practical dimensions of their respective fields. Keeping in mind the multi dimensional nature of problems and their interdisciplinary solutions, DAVIET has decided to diversify and offer new courses in addition to the already existing programs.
Department of Hospitality and tourism was established in 2019 to offer Bachelor of hospitality and tourism The department maintains an excellent teaching and learning environment with dedicated, qualified and dynamic faculty members and well equipped laboratories. The core competencies of the department include food production, food and beverage service, front office and housekeeping etc. The students of our department take up careers in various computing industries and large hotel companies, start up companies, management companies and other government based research organizations.
Department of hospitality and tourism balances the practical and theoretical aspects and provide students with a background for professional employment and also to pursue further studies in the discipline. This course is design so that one can give the best hospitality to the guest/customer.
DEPARTMENTAL LIBRARY
In addition to main library, a Departmental Library has also been set up which has books covering diverse research areas. Our departmental library has front office, food production, food and beverage service, housekeeping books which a student can go and take the advantage of.

ALLOTMENT OF SEATS
1. Hostel accommodation is allotted by the warden in consultation with the Chief Warden/Assistant Chief Warden on a "First Come First Served" basis. The allotment is done on condition that the student agrees to abide by the rules and regulations of the hostel.
2. Students must occupy rooms specifically allotted to them. They are not allowed to change rooms except with the written permission of the Warden/Assistant Chief Warden. However, students can pair up as per their choice within first few days. They may contact their hostel Warden for this purpose.
3. Allotment made to a student is subject to cancellation if he/she fails to clear all their dues to the hostel by the appointed day. In such cases they will be asked to vacate the hostel.
4. Full lodging charges will be charged from the resident scholars even if they joined the hostel in the middle of the session.
5. The Chief Warden/Assistant Chief Warden can refuse hostel facilities without assigning any reason/remove a resident from the hostel at any time on disciplinary grounds, in which case, the student may even be required to vacate the room at short notice.
6. Students may also be required to shift to alternate accommodation at short notice due to administrative reasons.
7. No booking / reservation will be entertained on telephone/Mobile/Whtsapp/ E mail.
Hostel fee is non refundable, only security is refundable
Electricity charges extra as per actual consumption.
